title: Passage 7
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Do you do team projects at school?
sentences.cn: 你在学校做团队项目吗？

sentences.en: I do a lot.
sentences.cn: 我做得很多。

sentences.en: I enjoy team projects because I like sharing ideas with other people.
sentences.cn: 我喜欢团队项目，因为我喜欢与他人分享想法。

sentences.en: Of course, team activities aren't always easy.
sentences.cn: 当然，团队活动并不总是那么容易。

sentences.en: You need to know how to work well together.
sentences.cn: 你需要知道如何更好地合作。

sentences.en: Here are some suggestions to make team work easier.
sentences.cn: 以下是一些让团队合作更轻松的建议。

sentences.en: Know the goals.
sentences.cn: 明确目标。

sentences.en: Make sure everyone understands the goal of the project.
sentences.cn: 确保每个人都了解项目目标。

sentences.en: If you're doing a class project,
sentences.cn: 如果你在做课堂项目，你需要仔细确认老师的指示，并使用字典来帮助明确所有信息。

sentences.en: you need to check the teacher's instructions carefully and use a dictionary to help make everything clear.
sentences.cn: 如果你在做课堂项目，你需要仔细确认老师的指示，并使用字典来帮助明确所有信息。

sentences.en: There's a popular saying: If you don't know where you're going, you probably won't get there.
sentences.cn: 有句俗话说得好：如果你不知道自己去哪里，你可能永远到不了那里。

sentences.en: Assign roles.
sentences.cn: 分配角色。

sentences.en: Everyone should have a role in the team.
sentences.cn: 团队中的每个人都应该有一个角色。

sentences.en: There should be a leader who helps everyone make decisions.
sentences.cn: 应该有一位领导者来帮助大家做决策。

sentences.en: There might be a note-taker who writes things down during meetings, and a timekeeper.
sentences.cn: 可能需要一位在会议期间做笔记的记录员，还有一位时间管理员。

sentences.en: There might also be a group speaker.
sentences.cn: 也可能要有一位小组发言人。

sentences.en: Divide the work.
sentences.cn: 任务分工。

sentences.en: For large projects, the work can be divided into smaller tasks.
sentences.cn: 对于大型项目，可以将工作分成更小的任务。

sentences.en: Then you can choose tasks that you do well.
sentences.cn: 然后你就可以选择那些你擅长的任务。

sentences.en: Of course, you shouldn't always do the same task, even if the new ones are difficult.
sentences.cn: 当然，你不应该总是做同样的任务，即使新任务很难。

sentences.en: Encourage each member to use their talents and try to assign a partner to each person,
sentences.cn: 鼓励每个成员用自己的才能，并尽量为每个人分配一个搭档，以便如果谁遇到困难，就有人可以帮助他。

sentences.en: so that somebody can help if anyone is struggling.
sentences.cn: 鼓励每个成员用自己的才能，并尽量为每个人分配一个搭档，以便如果谁遇到困难，就有人可以帮助他。

sentences.en: Make a plan.
sentences.cn: 制订计划。

sentences.en: After you divide the work, write down a plan on paper.
sentences.cn: 分工之后，在纸上写下计划。

sentences.en: You can use a calendar to help you.
sentences.cn: 你可以借助日历。

sentences.en: List all the tasks and think about when each one must be finished.
sentences.cn: 列出所有任务，并考虑每项任务必须完成的时间。

sentences.en: It's important for everyone to follow the plan.
sentences.cn: 每个人都遵循计划是很重要的。

sentences.en: Please communicate via email to keep everyone updated.
sentences.cn: 请通过电子邮件进行沟通，从而让每个人都了解最新情况。

sentences.en: And don't forget to always cheer each other on.
sentences.cn: 并且不要忘记时常互相加油打气。
